messages:
alex: Heads up — seeing a small but noisy spike of 502/504s hitting hosted inference in us-east-1 since ~10:42 UTC. Mostly streaming calls from guest/anonymous keys.

alex: Envoy logs show a lot of `upstream reset` + `stream closed` and occasional `h2 connection closed while pending` entries. Sample trace id: `trace=tx-9a7c4b`.

sam: Can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces? and any backend traces (edge -> backend) you have?

alex: Repro curl we used:```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer GUEST-123" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  --data '{"input":"generate long streaming response\"}' \\n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream/generate
```

alex: From envoy (abridged):
```
[2026-03-17T10:43:12Z] envoy upstream reset stream id=5: connection error, code=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
[2026-03-17T10:43:13Z] http2: RST_STREAM received, error_code=8 (ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM)
[2026-03-17T10:43:14Z] downstream request queued, pending_streams=100
```

maria: +1 looks like HTTP/2 stream saturation / pressure. Guest calls are sending large chunked payloads and simultaneously opening many streams. Do we have client-initiated concurrent_streams spikes in the metrics?

infra-bot: Alert: edge-us-east-1 envoy_conn_streams_high threshold breached (last 5m). Incident: #INC-29876 created.

sam: Can we check per-connection concurrent_streams and the `http2.connection_window_update` logs? Also confirm keepalive settings — if clients drop and reconnect frequently we can exhaust connection count.

emma: I saw similar during a bulk-embed job from a partner — mitigation was to lower `max_concurrent_streams` at the route/circuit-breaker and enforce a per-key rate limit on streaming endpoints. Could we toggle that as a quick canary?

alex: I can try a temporary per-route circuit breaker change (lower max pending = 50, max requests = 200) on canary cluster. Anyone opposed?

maria: Do it on canary (us-east-1-a) only. Also enable debug for `http2` on that envoy and capture a few minutes of `admin/cluster_stats` + `server` logs.

sam: Also ask billing to check whether a burst billing rule rotated keys recently — token rotation can cause auth clients to retry and open new streams.

alex: quick logs show an auth rotation job at 10:40: `billing-auth-rotate` ran across region. Could be correlated. Adding that to notes.

alex: Patching canary now: snippet below (envoy vhost route):
```
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - priority: DEFAULT
      max_pending_requests: 50
      max_requests: 200
      max_connections: 1000
```

infra-bot: Deploy job started: infra/canary/edge-config-update by alex (job id canary-2987).

maria: While canary rolls, let's also capture a failing request from customer X (guest) — request headers we want: `x-edge-trace`, `authorization`, `x-forwarded-for`, `content-length`. Ask support to attach one full request/response pair.

alex: Attached one sample (redacted): `x-edge-trace: tx-9a7c4b`, response status chain: 200 chunks then final 502 reset.

sam: If reset occurs after partial 200 chunks, likely upstream closed connection mid-stream. Could be model worker OOM or preemption when host reclaimed GPU for higher tier. Check Dedicated scaling events?

emma: On quick check, no recent preemptions in that 10:40 window. Model worker logs show repeated `write failure: broken pipe` correlated to the same trace ids.

maria: Action list:
- [alex] run canary config (in progress)
- [sam] grab full envoy admin dump + h2 metrics for 10:30-10:50
- [emma] tail model-worker stderr for `broken pipe` / OOMs and CPU spike charts
- [alex] attach customer request headers and trace ids to ticket

alex: Can confirm canary deployed; initial smoke looks better (edge-us-east-1-a: conn_streams dropped ~60% in 5m). We'll keep monitoring.

infra-bot: Canary deploy succeeded (canary-2987).

sam: If canary is stable, we should backfill config to the rest of the cluster and add a short-term rate-limit for guest keys to avoid recurrence while we investigate root cause.

alex: Will escalate to SRE oncall to approve cluster rollout and open a formal support ticket for the affected customers. Ticket: SUP-8791.

emma: One more ask — add a small increase to `http2.max_concurrent_streams` on the backend proxies (not edge) to reduce upstream resets if backends can handle it. Doable after safety window.

maria: Good. I also want long-term: QoS for streaming endpoints, prefer persistent connections for trusted keys, and throttling heuristics for anonymous/guest bursts.

alex: Thanks all — will post final RCA draft tomorrow after we gather backend logs and billing rotation timeline. :thumbsup:
